title: ADR: knowledge platform boundary — the platform owns document assembly, sync and reconcile, structural split and record-level return; `knowledge_source` becomes a governed type
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Source: topic #37000. Key words: 「需要拍板的事项 都同意」 (D1: platform owns assembly, sync & reconcile, structural split, record-level return; adapters own embedding calls, hybrid retrieval, rerank, file parsing — D2: `knowledge_source` becomes a governed metadata type referencing objects; no recipe on the object — D5: a source lists its content fields explicitly).
Grading: area:ai · Task · p3 · reach: n/a · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：一份决定记录，改掉「平台不做 RAG 引擎」的旧定位：平台负责把记录组成文档、同步与核对、简单的结构化切分、按记录返回；嵌入调用、混合检索、重排、文件解析仍归适配器。知识源变成受管理的元数据。
- 需要你做的：手工合并。

## What
One ADR in `docs/adr/` with `## Provenance` naming objectstack-ai/cloud#4960. It records:
1. The new boundary, and the texts it revises: `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` ("does not ship its own RAG engine"; "stored as metadata" vs the schema's "not a governed metadata type"), `packages/spec/src/ai/embedding.zod.ts` (chunking removed in v1), `packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts` (deliberately minimal), `knowledge-service.ts` / `knowledge-document.zod.ts` class notes.
2. What it supersedes, each by name: #4606's three judgements and its restart condition (BrightRule is the real object-source consumer), the adapter-list deferral in `knowledge-service-plugin.ts`, #4672's no-reconcile option, the 2026-11-15 words on #33933.
3. `knowledge_source` admission under ADR-0088 (own lifecycle, declarable governance, a real consumer); v1 keys = only those with an enforcer; the fate of the runtime-registration `file` / `http` shapes that `knowledge-ragflow` uses (one strict contract, AGENTS.md).
4. ADR-0087 dispositions for the renames and retirements (`id→name`, `contentFields→content`; `embedding`, `vectorStore`, `refresh.cron` removed).
5. One index fingerprint (model + dimensions + split config + split algorithm version + content recipe); a changed fingerprint means a new generation.
6. The adapter contract additions as a list, each tied to the child that is its first reader.
7. One `search_knowledge` definition for every transport (ADR-0149 D2); `aiExposed` stays at the tool layer (#36650).

## Acceptance
- PR open, Status Proposed. Governed surface: the maintainer merges by hand.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#4960
Parent: #37000. Reader: the seat that takes spec ADR text.
Dedupe: `knowledge_source` 0 · `is:open metadata type admission ADR-0088` 3 (#36868: precedent).
